<thought>To determine the number of CH₃ groups, I will first obtain the ¹³C NMR spectrum of the unknown sample. Methyl carbons typically appear in the upfield region (≈10–30 ppm). By counting distinct methyl carbon signals, I can infer the number of CH₃ groups. If the carbon spectrum is ambiguous, I could later use ¹H NMR or HSQC, but I’ll start with the carbon spectrum.</thought>
